description: This file contains test routines for checking protocol disabling in Git, including functions for cloning, fetching, and pushing with various configuration and environment settings. It sets up wrapper scripts for SSH and remote interactions, and defines multiple test cases for protocol allow/deny settings.

methods.name: test_allow_var
methods.description: Tests Git clone, fetch, and push operations with the GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL environment variable set to different protocol allowances.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Tests Git clone, fetch, and push operations using protocol allow configuration variables and environment variables.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Runs both protocol allowance environment variable tests and configuration tests for a specific protocol.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a custom SSH wrapper script to simulate SSH access during tests.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script to simulate remote repository access in test environment.
